title: Sort the front-row items into the crate and onto the tray (Unitree G1, fixed pelvis, Pink IK)
text: Put the two lemons from the front row of the table in the blue crate on your right, and the two limes from that row on the round tray on your left.
success: Success: both lemons are in the blue crate and both limes on the round tray, each resting there and still, and nothing that is not food is in the crate.
